A whitespace-only span opening a div does not indent the image after it into a code block

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>P</p>\n<div>\n<span>    </span><img alt=\"A\" src=\"S\"/>\n</div>")
puts result.content.inspect
```
